# Synthetic PDF fixtures

`encrypted.pdf` is a blank one-page PDF generated with pypdf 6.11.0 and encrypted
with a synthetic test password. It contains no production data. It verifies the
real parser's password-protection error, rather than a mocked parser exception.

Other valid/blank/long PDF fixtures are generated by
`src/tests/helpers/synthetic-pdf.ts`, including genuine page objects, streams and
xref offsets. Assertions check real extracted content and original-byte preservation.
No npm package metadata or lockfile entries are generated by these helpers.
